visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a white collared shirt and a purple apron stands in a bright indoor kitchen, using a chef's knife to rapidly slice green scallions on a yellow cutting board. (2) She continues by slicing ginger and a red chili into thin pieces, then crushes several garlic cloves with the flat side of the knife. (3) The woman presents a small rectangular ceramic plate containing the prepared aromatics arranged neatly. (4) She proceeds to cut two whole red tomatoes into large wedges and then slices long strips of raw beef ribs into thick cubes. (5) The beef is seen boiling in a pink pot on an induction stove, with gray foam rising to the surface. (6) The woman rinses the blanched beef under a faucet and displays the clean meat in a metal mesh strainer. (7) A blue tray is shown holding various condiments in small bowls, including red wine, soy sauce, tomato paste, and dry spices. (8) In a red cast-iron Dutch oven, the woman pours oil and adds the aromatics, stirring them with a pink spatula. (9) She adds bean paste, the blanched beef, sugar, soy sauce, tomato paste, and red wine, stirring the mixture until the beef is coated in a dark red sauce. (10) Tomato wedges and broth are added to the pot, which is then covered with a red lid to simmer. (11) The woman opens the lid, smiles widely at the camera while smelling the steam, and adds beef tendon and bay leaves. (12) Finally, she serves the cooked beef and rich broth over a bowl of wide, wavy noodles, garnishing the dish with fresh chopped green onions.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 蒜苗斜切成片. (2) [Subtitle]: 切幾片薑片. (3) [Subtitle]: 1~2條辣椒. (4) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍開. (5) [Subtitle]: 爆香的材料準備好了. (6) [Subtitle]: 去皮的番茄切成大塊狀. (7) [Subtitle]: 不去皮也是可以的 看自己. (8) [Subtitle]: 牛肋條稍微清洗乾淨 切成大塊狀. (9) [Subtitle]: 喜歡吃牛腱的朋友 可以切一點牛腱. (10) [Subtitle]: 切成厚厚的樣子 然後再對半切. (11) [Subtitle]: 切成大塊狀，會很好吃！ (12) [Subtitle]: 把牛肉放到溫水裡面汆燙. (13) [Subtitle]: 煮到上面佈滿血沫. (14) [Subtitle]: 撈起來放到溫水. (15) [Subtitle]: 接著再將表面雜質清洗乾淨... (這樣湯會比較乾淨). (16) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾備用... (17) [Subtitle]: 接著準備醬料的部分... (食譜請看留言板). (18) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡放入適量的油，開中火加熱 (若有牛油更好！). (19) [Subtitle]: 放入爆香材料 蒜頭、薑片、蒜苗、辣椒. (20) [Subtitle]: 輕輕地炒出香氣. (21) [Subtitle]: 接著放入辣豆瓣醬 炒出香味. (22) [Subtitle]: 放入所有的牛肉... 快速跟辛香料翻炒均勻. (23) [Subtitle]: 讓牛肉裹上香味~ (24) [Subtitle]: 加入15克左右的黑糖. (25) [Subtitle]: 拌炒均勻. (26) [Subtitle]: 嗆入醬油... (27) [Subtitle]: 20克的番茄膏 增加色澤. (28) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下... (29) [Subtitle]: 炒到牛肉紅紅的樣子... (30) [Subtitle]: 倒入紹興酒，增添風味！ (31) [Subtitle]: 把酒氣先揮發掉. (32) [Subtitle]: 接著放入所有的番茄塊. (33) [Subtitle]: 跟牛肉拌炒均勻. (34) [Subtitle]: 先讓番茄煮一下 直到軟化為止... (35) [Subtitle]: 加入高湯進來... (36) [Subtitle]: 高湯作法 請看我另外影片示範. (37) [Subtitle]: 可以加一點番茄醬 增加番茄的酸味~ (38) [Subtitle]: 把湯煮滾~ (39) [Subtitle]: 這時候放入兩片月桂葉 一顆八角提味... (40) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後，轉小火. (41) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋 先燉煮30分鐘... (42) [Subtitle]: 好囉~ 開蓋~ (43) [Subtitle]: 哇~ 好香喔. (44) [Subtitle]: 現在放入先前 已經煮軟的牛筋.. (45) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋 繼續燉煮30分鐘... (46) [Subtitle]: 好囉~ 開蓋！ (47) [Subtitle]: 哇~ 好香的味道~ (48) [Subtitle]: 撈掉一些油脂，會更清爽些.. (49) [Subtitle]: 一旁煮一些麵.. (50) [Subtitle]: 把牛肋、牛腱、牛筋放進來 淋上湯汁~ (51) [Subtitle]: 撒上蔥花... (52) [Subtitle]: 超級好吃的 紅燒番茄牛肉麵 就完成啦~~. (53) [Subtitle]: 這個牛筋好軟，肉好嫩. (54) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉~ (55) [Subtitle]: 好好吃喔~ (56) [Subtitle]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced acoustic guitar strumming starts immediately with a bright, uplifting piano melody. Multiple sharp, high-frequency rhythmic 'clacking' sound effects play in synchronization with the visual cutting of vegetables. (2) A metallic 'thud' SFX triggers as the aromatics plate is presented. BGM maintains a steady 128 BPM tempo with a light percussion backing. (3) A loud 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. It is followed by the sound of running water and a rhythmic 'crunching' sound effect during tomato slicing. (4) A low-frequency bubbling sound enters the mix as liquid is shown in the pot. The BGM remains dominant, but the sound of sizzling oil is clearly audible in the mid-range. (5) A 'ding' sound effect highlights the addition of new ingredients. The music swells slightly in volume during the stirring phase. (6) A sharp 'clink' of a pot lid is heard. The BGM continues smoothly. (7) A high-pitched, short 'Mmm' vocal sound from a female voice occurs, indicating satisfaction. The video ends with a final musical crescendo and a sharp cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy, step-by-step culinary guide for making Red-Braised Tomato Beef Noodles. It combines fast-paced visual editing with synchronized sound effects and cheerful BGM to make the cooking process appear both accessible and enjoyable. The final scene of tasting provides emotional payoff and validates the quality of the recipe.
